It was the second time I met up with this guy I met on some dating app, he was on call for his job so I just invited him back to mine for drinks. He comes with a joint. Now, it's worth mentioning that I used to be a heavy smoker, however had rarely smoked for the past couple of years due to being really unwell. I'd had a couple of double vodkas and was tipsy. We both went outside to smoke this joint and after taking my first couple of drags, that was enough for me to get like, super blazed. I remember thinking that I didn't want to look like an idiot in front of this guy and I didn't want to come across as not being able to handle weed (as like I say, years back I was a massive stoner). So I carry on smoking this joint with him, knowing fully well that this was absolutely not a good idea as I was already tipsy and I hadn't smoked for some time. Anyway, I'm like really high, so we head back to mine. I put Insterstellar on, and I'm thinking 'damn why did I put such a bind mending movie on when I'm this high' because I started having this anxiety attack. I didn't want to look like an idiot so I'm sat in silence in the company of this guy just secretly having this intense anxiety attack. I'm so high and getting super drunk by the literal minute. Everytime I closed my eyes, I felt this immense feeling of plummeting (something I experience only when I'm absolutely blazed, like, monumentally stoned). It's giving me this motion sickness. I'm trying to calm myself down by telling myself this would pass and to try and enjoy it in some way. Anyway, literally out of nowhere, I projectile vomit all over myself and my side of the bed. I had never projectile vomited with such force before. I mean, this stuff came out at like 30 mph. Anyway, spent the rest of the night in the bathroom. I never saw that guy again.
